units.source_text: 步出正门时，柏木的步法实在太独特，不由得引起我的注意，使我泛起了一股近乎羞耻的感情。

en.t: As we stepped out of the main gate, Kashiwagi's gait was so peculiar that it inevitably caught my attention and stirred in me a feeling almost like shame.

units.source_text: 自己如此袒护普通人的感情，觉得与棺木一起行走很难为情，这种感觉是十分奇异的。

en.t: It was an extremely strange feeling, this sense that I was defending ordinary human emotions so strongly and finding it embarrassing to walk alongside the coffin.
